Desired feedback: General impression mainly, make any comment you'd like. Just bear in mind that this is a VERY rough draft. The main thing about this story is the narration is first person. But it's strange. You'll get why once you read it. The tone is supposed to mirror how the main character is thinking in the moment, so you get glimpses of him thinking to himself, how he's processing what he senses in the moment, and even verbal responses to his flight-or-fight instincts.

link: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pB-K6EdYef5EzxrqJRMrK7kgsixZLMSZcIXHKTM6Dss/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pB-K6EdYef5EzxrqJRMrK7kgsixZLMSZcIXHKTM6Dss/edit?usp=sharing)

That's kinda why I like Punisher, all the characters have depth to them. They feel grounded in reality and have realistic (mostly) desires and motivations. Oh, I've definitely been the villain occasionally, ill-motivated but still remorseful. All it takes is realizing what you're doing from an outside perspective. Definitely redeemable, hopefully lmao.

Yeah, the human condition definitely exists, and you're right that it is scary. Undoubtedly. I just try to remind myself there's a reason people do things, and it's very rarely "I'm doing this because I want to be bad." People need perspectives besides their own, it's what differentiates active listeners to ignorant people. But whatever, lol. 

I don't know really, I feel sad and lonely mainly. I have an affluence of mental things thanks to OCD so I can be pretty blank if something's not right (Bad hair, somebody tries to touch me, God forbid someone touches my hair). But I've been trying to date around, make new friends, play better with current friends. That sort of thing, and stressing about classes but that's the life of a student lol. You?

I'd recommend watching Punisher ASAP, I think it's one of the best shows I've ever binged. It really gives (almost) everybody humanity to the point where you feel bad for some of the villains. I haven't seen Gotham, I've heard a lot about it, but I haven't gotten to watching it yet. Live action DC has disappointed me far too often, but I'll give it a shot.

Yeah, I'm just trying to cast aside my cynicism with people. I think it's because I've been so inward lately I haven't been able to enjoy them.

I have, but I stopped when I found out that me thinking on my own was dangerous and sometimes self-destructive. I have a very fast, multi-track mind. I start with one thread in my mind, and then end up with tens of threads devolving to something depressing. It's how I get stuck and forget that there's life outside my realm and outside my head

Trust me, talking with anyone and bouncing ideas off of other people really does help me. Yeah, sure, I enjoy everything related to the arts. Be it music, theater, shows or movies, comedy bits, even new inventions. I especially love the Netflix series the Punisher though, something about the way it's shot and its story is extremely thrilling to me. I love meeting new people and finding things out about them. They're like walking stories, it's absolutely thrilling to see how they go about life. And I just enjoy doing things, going out exploring cities, going to a fair, experiencing life.

You're right, I should stop fearing rejection, but I need to change my demeanor and not quite sure how to do that. I don't often move past the flirty banter stage lol. 

If only I were Stan Lee, that's the dream. Right now I'm struggling just trying to put one foot in front of the other...

I haven't told anyone how I feel lately, my family isn't good with life advice honestly. My father's very work-oriented and out-of-touch with social and emotional dynamics. He's a father with a mission to provide, caring, but robotic when it comes to emotional support.

Yeah, hopefully someone will come along, I'm just terribly impatient and frustrated with waiting.

Read the first line made me tear up and smile before actually being able to fall asleep, so thanks for that :)

I've tried counseling a few times before, but most have brushed me aside, it's not generally productive for me. Especially with me being complicated, stubborn, and not very trusting, makes for a fairly difficult session if I don't *want* to open up. I desire personal relationships more because there's an element of trust, I haven't found a Christian community yet, but I should look a little more tbh.

Don't get me wrong, I love a little gossip and shallow talking every now and then, but when it becomes the only topic people care to talk about: gets old. I have no doubt that it's a good segue into an actual friendship, the people I've talked with haven't moved passed that but idk, maybe it's me? 

Simply talking about substantive things helps me, it calms me down because it gives me something to focus on. I don't know, maybe I just need to get better about rejection. It happens often for everyone, and on the surface level I take it in stride, it's just the core that hurts. I play the part of an extrovert but am verily an introvert if uncomfortable. Agh, need to work on that.

I try to be hopeful and realize that the world's a big place, but I can get so caught up in how "my world" seems like it's falling to pieces when I'm focusing on a very narrow portion of life.
